new_page.title: Schools in Langley, BC | Full List by Level | Jared Gibbons
new_page.description: Browse 62 public and independent schools with a Langley address, grouped by level with street addresses. From the BC Ministry of Education and Child Care list

blocks.text: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care school list shows 62 schools with a Langley street address: 49 public schools and 13 independent schools. It also shows 5 college and university campuses. In that list, 7 schools marked as offering French Immersion, 1 Francophone school run by the Conseil scolaire francophone, 2 alternate programs and 2 online schools.

Public schools here are run by School District 35 (Langley) and School District 93 (Conseil scolaire francophone). Count by district: School District 35 (Langley): 48, School District 93 (Conseil scolaire francophone): 1.
Alternate programs, continuing education centres and online schools that have a street address sit under "other public schools and programs"; the level of every school is read from its name.
By mailing community, the Langley list splits as Langley (52), Aldergrove (8) and Fort Langley (2).

Public secondary schools with a Langley address: Aldergrove Community Secondary, Brookswood Secondary, D.W. Poppy Secondary, Langley Education Centre, Langley Fundamental Middle/Secondary Sch, Langley Secondary, R E Mountain Secondary and Walnut Grove Secondary.

The Ministry file marks these Langley schools as offering French Immersion: Alex Hope Elementary, Belmont Elementary, Brookswood Secondary, James Kennedy Elementary, Noel Booth Elementary, The King's School and Walnut Grove Secondary.

Independent schools listed for Langley include Aldergrove Christian Academy, COMPASS Christian Langley (Glover Rd.), Compass Christian New West, Credo Christian Schools, Fraser Valley Adventist Academy and Khalsa School of the Fraser Valley and 7 more.
Before an offer, ask the district which school serves the exact street address.
The Langley school district publishes its catchments only as an interactive map, not as a list of streets. Use the district's own page to check an address:
Langley school district catchments and school finder
The Conseil scolaire francophone publishes its attendance zones (zones de fréquentation) on its own site:
Conseil scolaire francophone attendance zones

The district's own school pages also list French Immersion at Alex Hope Elementary, Belmont Elementary, Brookswood Secondary, James Kennedy Elementary, Noel Booth Elementary, and Walnut Grove Secondary, where the Ministry file flag reads No. Confirm the program with the school before relying on either.
Langley is two municipalities, the City of Langley and the Township of Langley. This list covers both, plus Aldergrove and Fort Langley, and the Community column shows where each school sits.

faq.q: How many schools are in Langley, BC?
faq.a: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care list shows 62 schools with a Langley street address: 49 public schools and 13 independent schools. The count includes alternate programs and online schools that have a street address.
Public schools with a Langley address are run by School District 35 (Langley) and School District 93 (Conseil scolaire francophone).

faq.q: How do I find the catchment school for a Langley address?
faq.a: Ask School District 35 (Langley) and School District 93 (Conseil scolaire francophone) to confirm it for the exact street address.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.
